reasons: Both give the same correct diagnosis (default 30s gunicorn timeout killing the sync worker during the ~45s export) in English, and both propose the timeout stopgap plus moving the export to a background job. B sets nginx proxy_read_timeout strictly above the gunicorn timeout (150s vs 120s), so gunicorn fails first and logs it; A sets both to 120s. B also adds a direct curl reproduction, profiling and caching of the export, and post-change verification steps, which makes it somewhat more actionable.
